children.text: High School Reading Ambassadors spreading the joy of reading to our little Pre-KG learners!
Through this lovely initiative, our high school students became role models, sharing stories, inspiring young minds, and nurturing a love for books from an early age.
These meaningful moments strengthen connections across our school community and remind us that learning, kindness, and inspiration are best shared.
We are incredibly proud of our Reading Ambassadors for making a positive difference, one story at a time!

children.text: Congratulations to Reem Khaled on being the first female student from SAIS to take part in the ADEK Archery Competition!
We are excited to see her passion for archery grow as she takes the next step by joining the Abu Dhabi Archery Club and working towards competing at national level.
Reem, we wish you all the best on this journey. Keep aiming high! We are proud of you and look forward to seeing what you achieve next!

children.text: At Sharjah American International School, we believe that caring for our planet starts with the choices we make every day. Our Sustainability Fashion Show showcased the creativity and environmental awareness of our students, who transformed recycled and reusable materials into unique and inspiring fashion designs.
Through initiatives like this, we encourage our school community to reduce waste, reuse materials, and embrace sustainable practices, proving that small actions can make a big difference.
Together, we are shaping a greener future and nurturing a generation that cares for our planet!
